dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, is that a photo of Ratchanok Intanon on your phone?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ðæt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ˈrɑːtʃənɔːk ˈɪntənɑːn ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! She's my hero. I watch all her games.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ʃiːz maɪ ˈhɪroʊ. aɪ ˈwɑːtʃ ˈɔːl hɜːr ˈɡeɪmz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: She was world champion, wasn't she?
dialogue.reading: ʃiː wʌz ˈwɜːrld ˈtʃæmpiən, ˈwʌzənt ʃiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, in 2013, when she was only eighteen.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˌθɜːrˈtiːn, wɛn ʃiː wʌz ˈoʊnli ˌeɪˈtiːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Her parents worked at a dessert factory, and the owner had a badminton school there.
dialogue.reading: hɜːr ˈpɛrənts ˈwɜːrkt ət ə dɪˈzɜːrt ˈfæktəri, ənd ði ˈoʊnər ˈhæd ə ˈbædmɪntən ˈskuːl ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So she started playing at the factory?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ʃiː ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈpleɪɪŋ ət ðə ˈfæktəri?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. As a little girl, she would practice there for hours every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. əz ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɡɜːrl, ʃiː wʊd ˈpræktɪs ðɛr fər ˈaʊərz ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: She was dedicated from an early age.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː wʌz ˈdɛdɪkeɪtɪd frəm ən ˈɜːrli ˈeɪdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Very. She's hard-working and competitive, but she's also humble. I've never seen her show off.
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri. ʃiːz ˌhɑːrdˈwɜːrkɪŋ ənd kəmˈpɛtətɪv, bʌt ʃiːz ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈhʌmbəl. aɪv ˈnɛvər ˈsiːn hɜːr ˈʃoʊ ˈɔːf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: When I was a boy, I would play hockey every day in winter. But I wasn't very ambitious!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛn aɪ wʌz ə ˈbɔɪ, aɪ wʊd ˈpleɪ ˈhɑːki ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ ɪn ˈwɪntər. bʌt aɪ ˈwʌzənt ˈvɛri æmˈbɪʃəs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ratchanok was very ambitious. She wanted to be number one in the world, and she did it!
dialogue.reading: ˈrɑːtʃənɔːk wʌz ˈvɛri æmˈbɪʃəs. ʃiː ˈwɑːntɪd tə bi ˈnʌmbər ˈwʌn ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld, ənd ʃiː ˈdɪd ɪt!
